projects.title: Competition team coverage
projects.summary: We follow an academy's team through a full tournament day: warm-ups, every match, the podium. The gym gets a highlight per athlete and one team film to post that night.
deliverables: Vertical cuts for Reels and TikTok

projects.title: Kids & juniors programme

projects.title: Athlete spotlights

projects.title: Event & seminar promo
